items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Wraps Upfront Ad Sales With Commitments Nearly Doubling
items.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) has completed its 2026-27 TV upfront ad sales, with advertising commitments nearly doubling year over year. The company described this as a significant jump in ad commitments, which supports its push to grow advertising as a key revenue stream. Management has linked this progress to Netflix's previously stated goal of reaching about US$3b in annual ad revenue by 2026. Growing interest in ad supported models across streaming is part of a wider income focused trend...

items.title: NFLX Stock: Where Compounding Could Take The Price
items.summary: While the market sees a mature streaming giant, a new growth engine is quietly spooling up inside the business. The company's push into cloud games is showing remarkable traction, with monthly players having increased 11x since last October. This adoption is already outpacing the company's earlier, successful push into mobile games.
